subject: Kitchen receipt printer PRN-0087-P1 not detected by StarMC Print system
description: The kitchen receipt printer (asset PRN-0087-P1) connected to the POS terminal at Jubilee Hills location is not being detected by StarMC Print v3.0 software. The printer was functioning normally until approximately 06:45 AM today when orders stopped printing to the kitchen display. The device appears powered on (LED indicator lit), but when I navigate to Devices > Printers in StarMC Print admin panel, the printer does not appear in the available devices list. I have already performed the following troubleshooting steps: (1) power cycled the printer by disconnecting USB cable for 30 seconds and reconnecting; (2) verified USB cable is firmly connected to both printer and POS terminal; (3) checked Windows Device Manager on the POS terminal and the printer shows as 'Unknown Device' with a yellow exclamation mark; (4) attempted to reinstall the printer driver from the StarMC installation media but installation failed with error code 0x80070005 (Access Denied). This is impacting kitchen operations as we cannot print order tickets, causing delays in order fulfillment. Business impact is moderate as we are currently relying on manual verbal communication with kitchen staff. Store is operational but efficiency is significantly reduced. Hardware details confirmed: Printer model is StarMC KPR-400 thermal receipt printer, serial number SN-KPR-087-4521, connected via USB-A to POS terminal asset ID POS-0087-M1.

ticket_history.note: Ticket received and reviewed. Confirmed printer asset PRN-0087-P1 details in system. Initial assessment: likely USB driver or hardware communication issue. Advised submitter to check for Windows driver updates and attempt manual driver installation from manufacturer website as next troubleshooting step.

Contacted store manager to confirm printer status. Device Manager showing 'Unknown Device' indicates driver corruption or hardware failure. Escalation to L2 hardware team recommended due to persistent access denied error during driver installation.
